rows.grounds: compound naming a head marked by Viṣṇu's foot

items.question: What blessing is being invoked for the long-lived one whose head bears Viṣṇu's foot-mark?
items.inference: The verse invokes gracious blessing upon the immortal marked one.
uncertainties: Morphological case of śirāḥ is uncertain; treated as nominative singular.
items.plain_english: May the long-lived one whose head is marked by Viṣṇu's foot be gracious.
